title: Tomato & Spinach Scramble
description: A quick, nourishing skillet scramble utilizing fresh greens and juicy tomatoes.
instructions: Dice tomatoes and wash spinach.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté tomatoes and spinach for 2 min until wilted.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper; pour into skillet.
Gently scramble for 3 min until softly set.

title: Classic Vegetable Frittata
description: Golden baked Italian omelette loaded with tender potatoes and savory onions.
instructions: Sauté diced potatoes and onions in oil until tender (8 min).
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour eggs over vegetables and cook on low heat until bottom sets.
Flip or broil until golden and cooked through.

title: Garlic & Egg Fried Rice
description: The ultimate leftover rice makeover with fragrant garlic and fluffy scrambled eggs.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan; fry minced garlic until golden.
Push garlic to side, crack eggs in pan and scramble.
Add cold cooked rice and break up any clumps.
Season with soy sauce and salt; toss on high heat for 3 min.

title: Rustic Potato & Onion Hash
description: Crispy pan-fried potato cubes with caramelized onions seasoned simply.
instructions: Dice potatoes into small 1 cm cubes; slice onion.
Parboil potatoes for 5 min, then drain well.
Crisp potatoes and onions in hot oil for 12-15 min.
Season generously with salt and pepper; serve crisp.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: Refreshing pantry salad combining plump chickpeas, crisp vegetables, and zesty lemon dressing.
instructions: Rinse and drain canned chickpeas.
Dice tomatoes and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
Combine chickpeas and vegetables in a mixing bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and salt; toss gently.

title: Simple Garlic Aglio e Olio Pasta
description: Traditional Italian pasta coated in rich, fragrant garlic and chili infused olive oil.
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Thinly slice garlic cloves.
Gently warm olive oil in pan; sauté garlic and chili until fragrant.
Toss drained pasta into garlic oil with 2 tbsp pasta water.

title: Creamy Lentil & Spinach Dhal
description: Hearty spiced red lentils simmered with tender spinach leaves and warming aromatics.
instructions: Rinse red lentils and simmer in water for 15 min until soft.
In a pan, fry chopped onion and garlic in oil until translucent.
Add curry powder, then stir fried onions into lentils.
Fold in spinach and salt; simmer 3 min until wilted.

title: Cheese & Herb Omelette
description: A velvety French-style folded omelette with a gooey melted cheese center.
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in eggs; let edges set then draw cooked egg to center.
Sprinkle cheese over half, fold in half, and slide onto plate.

title: Crispy Pan-Roasted Rosemary Potatoes
description: Golden skillet roasted potato wedges scented with rosemary and crushed garlic.
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges.
Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet.
Arrange potatoes cut-side down; fry for 15 min turning once.
Add crushed garlic, rosemary, and salt; toss until fragrant and crisp.

title: Quick Tomato & Cannellini Bean Stew
description: Rich tomato stew simmered with tender cannellini beans, onions, and sweet garlic.
instructions: Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil for 4 min.
Add tomatoes and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in drained white beans and salt.
Simmer for 10 min until thick and rich.

title: Stir-Fried Egg Noodles with Vegetables
description: Speedy wok tossed egg noodles with crunchy carrots and cabbage in savory soy sauce.
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package, drain.
Heat oil in a wok; stir-fry sliced carrot and cabbage for 3 min.
Add drained noodles into wok.
Drizzle with soy sauce and black pepper; toss over high heat for 2 min.

title: French Onion Melt Toast
description: Crusty toasted bread loaded with sweet caramelized onions and bubbling cheese.
instructions: Melt half the butter in a pan; caramelize sliced onions with salt (10 min).
Butter outer sides of bread slices.
Fill bread with caramelized onions and cheese.
Toast both sides in a hot skillet until golden and cheese melts.

title: Curried Fried Egg with Steamed Rice
description: Crispy fried eggs in bubbling curry oil served hot over warm leftover rice.
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a small frying pan.
Add curry powder and bloom for 15 seconds.
Crack in eggs; spoon spiced oil over whites until crispy.
Serve over warm steamed rice and sprinkle with salt.

title: Sautéed Garlic Spinach with Butter
description: Tender fresh spinach leaves quickly sautéed with golden garlic slices and rich butter.
instructions: Melt butter in a wide pan over medium heat.
Sauté sliced garlic until lightly golden.
Add spinach in batches, tossing until just wilted.
Season with salt and black pepper; drain excess liquid and serve.

title: Mushroom & Garlic Pan Sauté
description: Seared button mushrooms with browned garlic, butter, and cracked black pepper.
instructions: Wipe mushrooms clean and slice in halves or quarters.
Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over high heat.
Sauté mushrooms without crowding for 6 min until golden brown.
Add minced garlic, salt, and pepper; toss for 1 min.

title: Sweet Cinnamon French Toast
description: Stale bread revived in a rich spiced egg batter and pan-toasted until caramelized.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and sugar in a shallow dish.
Dip bread slices into mixture, soaking both sides.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook bread slices for 3 min per side until golden brown.

title: Zesty Tuna & Sweetcorn Salad
description: Flaked tuna and sweet sweetcorn tossed in a creamy lemon and pepper dressing.
instructions: Drain canned tuna and sweetcorn.
Flake tuna into a bowl and mix with sweetcorn.
Stir in mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Toss thoroughly and serve chilled or as a sandwich filling.

title: Shakshuka-Style Poached Eggs in Tomato
description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced, simmering garlic and cumin tomato reduction.
instructions: Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil for 4 min.
Add tomatoes, salt, and cumin; simmer 10 min until sauce thickens.
Make 3 small wells in the tomato sauce.
Crack an egg into each well; cover pan and simmer 5 min until whites set.
